cards.title: 特朗普访华与深圳 APEC 经贸外交博弈对中美股市传导
cards.title_en: Trump China Visit & Shenzhen APEC Trade Impact on A-Shares & US Stocks
cards.beginner_explainer: 大国元首面对面会晤直接决定未来 6–12 个月的「关税税率」和「科技出口限制」。只要双方释放缓和或阶段性经贸协议信号，之前被压低估值的中概股、A股出口链和航运就会迎来“预期差修复”；相反，如果谈拢有限或科技限制加码，资金会迅速转向 A 股国产替代（半导体设备/信创）。
cards.beginner_explainer_en: US-China leader summits directly reprice tariff risk and tech export controls. Any de-escalation sparks relief rallies in Chinese ADRs and export chains, whereas renewed curbs rotate domestic A-share capital into semiconductor self-sufficiency.

cards.title: Anthropic 千亿级超级 IPO 与英伟达换帅/算力链重估
cards.title_en: Anthropic Record IPO & NVIDIA Governance Transition Re-rating
cards.category_tag: AI 资本开支与算力链
cards.beginner_explainer: Anthropic 创纪录 IPO（募资超 800–1000 亿美元）意味着全球资本市场给“大模型公司”定下了全新估值锚——融资来的钱最终会大举买算力卡、光模块、服务器和数据中心电力；同时英伟达虽然业绩亮眼但面临管理层交接与出口审查，会导致资金在「英伟达单核」与「AMD/自研芯片/国产算力」之间重新切分。
cards.beginner_explainer_en: Anthropic's historic IPO sets a fresh valuation anchor for frontier AI labs and injects massive capital into compute, optics, and data centers, while NVIDIA's leadership transition sparks rotation across AMD, custom ASICs, and domestic compute peers.

cards.title: 美联储鹰派加息预期升温与美元/黄金剧烈波动
cards.title_en: Hawkish Fed Rate Expectations & USD / Gold Volatility
cards.category_tag: 央行利率与全球流动性
cards.beginner_explainer: 利率就是“借钱的成本”。一旦美联储官员释放加息或推迟降息信号，美债收益率和美元会走强——这会让“不生息的黄金”瞬间失去吸引力（资金流向吃利息的美元），同时让“靠未来画大饼的高估值科技股”折现承压；反过来，银行和现金流稳健的高股息红利板块往往更抗跌。
cards.beginner_explainer_en: Higher Fed rate expectations strengthen the USD and Treasury yields, pressuring non-yielding gold and high-multiple growth stocks while favoring defensive high-dividend banks and cash-rich value names.
transmission_chain: 美联储纪要偏鹰 / 官员提及加息 50bp 风险

无息资产黄金短线失血（跌破 3800 美元关口）
资金从高估值成长股切换至高股息防御板块
transmission_chain_en: USD Index climbs above 103.8 + yields rise
